data.name: Logix Apple II Expansion Card

specification.software: Native Apple II 6502 FlexiBUS/disk drivers and examples; no CP/M or Z80 execution capability.
specification.sourcing: AION chips at June 1979 launch; qualified SMC alternatives after their individual release, no earlier than October 1979.

manufacturing_requirements: Apple bus decode/buffering and connector, identification/boot/driver ROM size, port-controller count, transceivers and any FIFO, Disk II sequencing/data handling, timing and firmware ownership. Freeze how native Disk II and FlexiBUS drive access coexist. Existing retail price is not component cost.
